record.question: How does radioembolization (SIRT) differ from TACE?
options: SIRT uses chemotherapy drugs, while TACE uses radioactive microspheres.
SIRT uses radioactive microspheres delivered to the tumor via the hepatic artery.
SIRT uses external beam radiation, while TACE uses internal radiation.
SIRT is a surgical procedure, while TACE is an interventional procedure.
record.explanation: Answer B: SIRT uses radioactive microspheres delivered to the tumor via the hepatic artery.. SIRT delivers radioactive microspheres via the hepatic artery; TACE delivers chemotherapy plus embolic material. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
